zones.energy: Can you sustain energy throughout the day without crashes? This zone tracks your glucose, insulin, ketones, and thyroid function.
zones.structural: Are your bones, muscles, and connective tissues strong? Calcium, magnesium, protein, and vitamin D build your structural scaffolding.
zones.cardiovascular: How strong is your heart and circulation? This zone focuses on true cardiovascular risk through particle count (ApoB), blood pressure, and lipid ratios.
zones.cognitive: Is your brain sharp, memory clear, and mood stable? B vitamins, magnesium, thyroid hormones, and sex hormones directly impact cognition.
zones.immune: Is your immune system balanced? White blood cells, vitamin D, zinc, and selenium determine your immune resilience.
zones.nutritional: Do you have enough micronutrients to run your cells optimally? Vitamins and minerals are cofactors for thousands of enzymes.
zones.hormonal: Are your hormones optimized for your age? Sex hormones and stress hormones orchestrate metabolism, mood, libido, and recovery.
zones.detoxification: Can your body efficiently process and eliminate waste? Your liver and kidneys are the filtration system.

thresholds.explanation: Reference range defaults are based on your diet protocol
thresholds.explanationDetail: Values inside the green range are optimal. Values between green and orange boundaries are acceptable (yellow). Values outside the orange boundaries are flagged as critical (red). Red boundaries are calculated automatically from your orange values. Change the unit to see reference ranges auto-converted.
